audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phase sides marked level 1 'Skill' and level 3 'Jayce', contradicting whys[0] (you out-range him clean) and whys[2] (a skill fight once Quickdraw is up).
audit.why: Quickdraw is not leveled at 1, so the orb is free; at 3 it exists and he can dash the orb and close.
audit.corrected: Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Jayce, Skill, Skill, Jayce.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase text called level 6 a shared spike and 'Graves's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: Jayce's R is the stance-swap he already had, so he has no level-6 spike; Collateral Damage at 100s plus his Quickdraw resists is a real one for Graves.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is contested, not yours; your spikes are Acceleration Gate at 2-3 and Eclipse.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places said Smoke Screen blinds your cannon autos; and the decisive interaction — Graves' bullets cannot pass through units — was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's Smoke Screen text reduces sight range and slows on impact; there is no blind. New Destiny fires four bullets that cannot pass through units, so a minion between you and Graves eats his entire auto while your Shock Blast still reaches him.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows; stand behind a minion to blank his shotgun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Advice was 'engage when Quickdraw is down' with no number and no caveat.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s AND its cooldown is lowered by his basic attacks, so a farming Graves almost never has it fully down — you must bait it, not wait for it.
audit.corrected: Bait the dash with a faked cannon-Q rather than waiting on a timer.

edits.before: Drop Smoke Screen to blind your cannon autos and slow you while he reloads or disengages
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to cut your sight range and slow you while he reloads or disengages

edits.before: Graves has to walk into shotgun range to last-hit, so this is your window — gate-Q (Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate) his step-ups and chunk him before his Quickdraw dash is leveled to slip the orb. Don't dump Hyper Charge into him at point-blank; he'll Quickdraw out and reload-burst you back. Poke from max gate range, respect that his shotgun autos hit like a truck up close, and don't sit in his Smoke Screen where it blinds your cannon autos and slows you out of poke range.
edits.after: Graves has to walk into shotgun range to last-hit, so this is your window — gate-Q (Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate) his step-ups and chunk him before his Quickdraw dash is leveled to slip the orb. Don't dump Hyper Charge into him at point-blank; he'll Quickdraw out and reload-burst you back. Poke from max gate range, keep a minion between you because his four bullets cannot pass through units, and stay out of Smoke Screen, which cuts your sight range and slows you out of poke range.

edits.before: Cannon Q-poke wins range wars before minions even matter. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Cannon Q out-ranges a shotgun that must walk to the wave, and Quickdraw is not leveled yet — chip him on every last-hit step.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Graves must walk into your range.
edits.after: With Quickdraw up he can dash the orb and close — it turns into your gate poke against his reload burst.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Quickdraw's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You still out-poke a Graves without level 6 or items — gate-Q his last-hits and threaten the swap-shred Hammer combo.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Quickdraw (E): 16s at rank 1, but every basic attack he lands shortens it, so it is rarely truly down while he is farming. - Smoke Screen (W): 26s at rank 1. - Collateral Damage (R): 100s at rank 1 — his answer to your poke war.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His dash plus resist stacks, 16s — but his autos shorten it, so bait it, do not wait.

edits.before: No permanent owner here — the level chart shows where momentum tilts and tilts back.
edits.after: Yours at levels 1-2 and 4-5; contested at 3 and 6 once Quickdraw and his ult land.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Gate-Q poke + hammer knock.
edits.after: His four bullets cannot pass through units — keep a minion between you and his shotgun does nothing while your orb still lands.

notes: Smoke Screen does not blind — it reduces sight range and slows. Side/win enum fields are not prose; the length band should not apply to them.
